html:
G'oya

"Har bir nasiya vaqtida uzilgan" degani "vaqtida uzilmagan nasiya yo'q" degani. Bu NOT EXISTS. Lekin nasiyasi umuman yo'q mijozda ham "yomon nasiya yo'q", shuning uchun yoniga EXISTS qo'shamiz: kamida bitta nasiya bo'lsin.

Yechim

SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM debts d WHERE d.customer_id = c.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM debts d
    WHERE d.customer_id = c.id
      AND (d.paid_day IS NULL OR d.paid_day - d.taken_day > 10)
  )

"Yomon nasiya" ikki xil: hali uzilmagan yoki 10 kundan kech uzilgan. Ikkalasi ham ichki shartda OR bilan yozilgan.

Tuzoqlar

Asosiy tuzoq NULL. Malikaning 20-kungi nasiyasi hali uzilmagan, paid_day - taken_day esa NULL beradi. NULL > 10 rost emas, shuning uchun bu nasiya "yomon" deb topilmaydi va Malika ishonchli bo'lib qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM debts d WHERE d.customer_id = c.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM debts d
    WHERE d.customer_id = c.id
      AND d.paid_day - d.taken_day > 10
  )

EXISTS ni unutsangiz, daftarda umuman yo'q Jasur ham chiqadi. Aziz 25-kuni uzgan nasiyani 15-kuni olgan, roppa-rosa 10 kun: u vaqtida, shuning uchun > 10, >= 10 emas.

Boshqa yo'l

Guruhlab ham tekshirsa bo'ladi. COUNT(paid_day) NULL larni sanamaydi, u COUNT(*) ga teng bo'lsa, hamma nasiya uzilgan:

SELECT id, name
FROM customers
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM debts
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(paid_day) = COUNT(*)
     AND MAX(paid_day - taken_day) <= 10
)
